name: Principal
source:
The principal of Yuuta's new school.
She is trying to keep her dignity by showing no friendliness to her students.
However, some say that she has been keeping her true nature hidden...
While she does her best to deal with all the school's problems, it seems there is an infinity of those coming in day after day.

[From in-game charater profile]
